title: Dragon Quest RPG Mobile Game's Trailer Reveals 2027 Launch, Closed Beta Test in December
content: The Dragon Quest franchise announced that Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle ( Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-Ju to Michibikareshi Shima ), a new game for iOS and Android devices, will launch in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online Creator’s New Anime Confirms How Long It’s Going to Be
content: The creator behind Sword Art Online has a new anime now airing its episodes through the Fall, and a new update has revealed just how long Devils’ Crest is going to be sticking around for.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Streams Suikoden Anime
content: The series began streaming with English subtitles on YouTube for free beginning on October 6 with new episodes on Tuesdays. The stream is available in North America, Latin America, the Caribbean, Ireland, parts of Africa and the Middle East, and in New Zealand and Australia.
author: ANN

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run Shows Off Its Stands With New Trailer – Watch
content: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run has been airing its new episodes through the Fall, and a special new trailer is showing off all of the cool new Stands that have made their debuts thus far.
author: ComicBook

title: Get Backers Teases Return With Mysterious 'Strongest Duo' Video, No New Anime Project Announced
content: Get Backers appears to be preparing for a new revival project, with the franchise’s official YouTube channel confirming that it is behind the mysterious teaser recently shared on X.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kodansha's Comic Tint Digital Magazine to End After 9 Years
content: The 103rd issue of Kodansha 's Comic Tint digital manga magazine announced on Friday that the magazine will cease its run, with its last issue being the 105th issue debuting on January 1. Manga in the magazine will move to Kodansha 's digial magazine Ane Friend and the Palcy manga app.
author: ANN

title: DMM Establishes New Animation Studio Gleestone
content: DMM.com announced on Tuesday that it has established GLEESTONE, a new animation studio which will handle animation works — including television series, movies, and shorts — from their initial planning stages to the actual animation production.
author: ANN

title: Light Novel 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu' Concludes with 10th Volume
content: The official X account for author Nana Mikoshiba announced on Tuesday that the Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu: Sekai Saikyou no Majutsushi de Aru Shounen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ni Nyuugaku suru ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) light novel series will end with its tenth volume, scheduled to be…
author: MyAnimeList

title: Hollywood Reporter, Variety: Apple TV in Talks for Monarch: Legacy of Monsters Season 3
content: Entertainment news magazines The Hollywood Reporter and Variety reported on October 29 that Apple TV and Legendary Television are in talks for a possible third season of the Monarch: Legacy of Monsters series, part of Warner Bros. and Legendary Entertainment 's "Monsterverse" franchise .
author: ANN

title: Shueisha Games to Publish Nightmare Operator Action Horror Game
content: Shueisha Games announced on Tuesday that it will publish game developer DDDistortion's third-person action horror shooter NIGHTMARE OPERATOR , which will launch on PC via Steam . The announcement also presented the game's teaser trailer, key art, and voice actress Miyuki Sawashiro as the voice of protagonist Misha.
author: ANN
